verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for an equity-management SaaS, which could expose an API or CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive web workflows, bulk upload, and a first-party Gusto sync, none of which is headless or CI-driven operation. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, and markdown docs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
